messages:
ana: Console alert: structured-validation.failure rate jumped for routeId=partner-intl. Mostly enum mismatch on "action_type". Anyone seen partner traffic like this?

ben: Sampled payload shows mixed casing: {"action_type":"Open-File", "file":{"path":"/tmp/creds"}}. Schema expects snake_case lower enums. Validator marks as soft fail.

ravi: This coincides with the strict-schema canary flip. Canary was supposed to tag events but the edge proxy dropped the tag for forwarded requests. So canary events look like prod and inflate the failure rate. Filed INF-318.

observability-bot: alert: structured-validation.failures > 0.015 for routeId=partner-intl (us-east) 6a7 triggered at 2026-03-23T08:12:00Z

emma: Two issues to solve: 1) telemetry sampling/tagging bug, 2) sampled payloads showing raw data (PII risk). Need redacted-by-default for console samples.

ben: Proposal: emit fncall.validation.soft_failures and fncall.validation.hard_failures. Soft failures should not affect quota/SLA. Also change dashboard to show both series.

product-analyst: UX note: add tooltip: "Soft validation: auto-fallbacked to permissive model; visible for debugging; not billed unless org opts in." Also make raw-sample reveal admin-only with audit log.

ana (ana): For partners, offer an opt-in adapter helper that coerces enums (case-insensitive). Default behavior remains strict.

ravi: I'll patch metrics and tag retention in the canary. Ben can implement redaction in sampler. After canary, we should run a backfill to recompute SLA windows for last 72h to silence false alerts.

observability-bot: deploy started: eng-platform/patch/enum-redact -> us-east at 2026-03-23T08:22:10Z (ravi) :rocket:

ben: Opening PR for redaction + admin reveal link. Will gzip redacted payloads and log raw-access with audit event.

emmaa (typo): emma: Dashboard change pushed: stacked soft/hard series, legend, and raw-toggle (admin only). Left comments referencing INF-318 and PR link.

ravi: Canary metrics show soft_failures now separated and quota counts unaffected for test traffic. Scheduling backfill check with ops.

product-analyst: Added changelog blurb about validation semantics and sample visibility so CS has talking points.

ana (ana): Follow-ups: 1) INF-318 fix for tag retention 2) backfill SLA recalculation 3) redaction + admin raw view 4) adapter helper for enum coercion. Promote after 2h if stable.

observability-bot: scheduled check-in in 2h for routeId=partner-intl.

emma: Thanks team, closing thread unless partner files a ticket.
